clauses.clause: cl. 1(a): section 48(a)(7)(A) of the Internal Revenue Code shall not apply to a taxpayer's acquisition of any article with unit cost not over $500
cl. 1(b): same exemption for agricultural implements, machinery and equipment the Secretary of the Treasury determines to be duty-free, with lists to be published in the Federal Register
cl. 2: the order applies to described property acquired under an order placed after 15 Aug 1971 and before 20 Dec 1971

propositions.claim: EO 11666 was printed in the Federal Register of 12 April 1972 at 37 FR 7199, dated 11 April 1972.
propositions.quote: EXECUTIVE ORDER 11666 ... FEDERAL REGISTER, VOL. 37, NO. 71— WEDNESDAY, APRIL 12, 1972

propositions.claim: The order rests on IRC section 48(a)(7)(C) and disapplies section 48(a)(7)(A) for described acquisitions.
propositions.quote: it is hereby ordered that section 48(a)(7)(A) shall not apply to an acquisition by the taxpayer of:
(a) Any article the unit cost of which to the taxpayer is not in excess of $500; or

propositions.claim: Item (b) covers duty-free agricultural equipment as determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, with lists to be published.
propositions.quote: Agricultural implements, machinery, and equipment which are determined by the Secretary of the Treasury to be free of duty under an item of the tariff schedules

propositions.claim: The order has no expiry clause; it limits its subject matter to acquisitions ordered in a closed 1971 window that had already passed when it was signed.
propositions.quote: shall apply to property described herein acquired pursuant to an order placed by the taxpayer after August 15, 1971, and before December 20, 1971.

review.conclusion_reason: The worker appropriately leaves the operative question unresolved: a retrospective eligibility window does not establish expiry, and an unnamed general amendment does not satisfy the prescribed ending rules. The formal finding is supportable only as a limited report that no express ending was found in these materials.
missed_evidence: The cited govinfo section 48 page, Effective Date of 1990 Amendment, lines 1201–1202, says the amendment applies to property placed in service after December 31, 1990 and lists transition exceptions. This materially qualifies the proposed 1990 ending and partially answers the second gap, without establishing an ending for this order.

verdicts.reason: Held official-PDF OCR identifies EO 11666, 37 FR 7199, signing date April 11 and publication April 12, 1972.
The opening paragraph expressly cites section 48(a)(7)(C) and disapplies section 48(a)(7)(A).
Paragraph (a) expressly covers unit costs not exceeding $500.
Paragraph (b) confirms Treasury's duty-free determination and lists to be published from time to time in the Federal Register.
The final paragraph limits the dates of taxpayer orders, not the duration of the exemption; no express expiry appears in the complete held text.
The cited Code page's 1990 amendment note confirms the general rewrite by section 11813(a); no occurrence of 11666 appears. This supports only a candidate ending.
Accurately quotes the supplied slice and explicitly discloses that the underlying OFR table was not inspected; the classification itself remains unverified.
